title: LA This Week #1420
description:
On this episode of LA This Week: Tour historic City Hall, explore the new Lucas Museum in Exposition Park, access free LADWP recycled water, unveil Kagel Canyon’s new accessible playground, welcome Quebec’s Super Scoopers, honor 9/11 first responders, kick off Angeleno Corps, celebrate cumbia legends Los Ángeles Azules, march in Wilmington’s Labor Day Parade, connect at Fall Friday Nights in MacArthur Park, experience the Caribbean Heritage Festival, access community support at St. Joseph Center, shape city accessibility, and celebrate the HiFi Fall Festival in Historic Filipinotown.
